components: Three supplied orthogonal neutral contrasts on four rails have unsigned path witnesses. A three-factor Cartesian source, coherent factor permutations, signed cancellation and a complete ordered-pair router implement a cyclic classifier with two retained flags. The cyclic sum is not the standard-sector output.

On that same carrier, a standard-sector source and a balanced incoherent mixture of symmetric and antisymmetric flags agree on all three single pair-swap averages and same-pair repeats. The cyclic classifier accepts the mixture with fraction one and the standard source with fraction zero. Two different successive pair contacts already distinguish the named sources (agreement one versus one quarter).

On three neutral rails the alternating three-factor construction vanishes by trilinearity on a two-dimensional local basis. The four-rail discrimination does not select Bose, Fermi or any other physical exchange statistics.
candidates.declared_status: Finite conditional exchange-sector discrimination under explicit preparation and readout resources, not a derivation of physical particle statistics, general composition, detector events or QM.
missing_bridges: Justify the shared four-rail carrier, its three supplied contrast preparations, Cartesian factor addresses and coherent factor-exchange operations as physical resources.
Supply a physical detector and sector-selection law; pair-swap averages alone do not identify the exchange sector, and the cyclic classifier is not a uniquely required discriminator.
